discover.description: Client asks any listening sync server on the selected UDP port to identify itself.

discover_response.description: Server advertises the TCP endpoint that clients can connect to.

sync_ping.description: Server sends a timing probe used to estimate round trip time and client clock offset.

id.description: Protocol operation identifier for matching this ping to its pong.

serverSendMs.description: Server monotonic timestamp in milliseconds when the ping was sent.

sync_pong.description: Client replies to a timing probe with receive and send timestamps.

id.description: Protocol operation identifier copied from sync_ping.

clientReceiveMs.description: Client monotonic timestamp in milliseconds when sync_ping was received.

clientSendMs.description: Client monotonic timestamp in milliseconds when sync_pong was sent.

prepare.description: Coordinator sends a command frame for the peer to stage before synchronized execution.

id.description: Protocol operation identifier for matching prepare, ready, and fire messages.

timestampMs.description: Coordinator timestamp in milliseconds when the prepare message was created.

line.description: Optional source CSV line number for logging and traceability.

targetType.description: Target command type, for example speed or torque.

targetValue.description: The value for the target command.

starter.description: Coordinator announces the start of a simulation stream before the first prepare message.

lineCount.description: Total number of simulate-able data rows in this run.

ready.description: Peer confirms that a prepared command frame is staged and ready to fire.

id.description: Protocol operation identifier copied from prepare.

timestampMs.description: Peer timestamp in milliseconds when the prepared command became ready.

line.description: Optional source CSV line number copied from prepare.

fire.description: Coordinator tells every staged participant to execute the prepared command for the given sequence.

id.description: Protocol operation identifier copied from prepare.

timestampMs.description: Coordinator timestamp in milliseconds when the fire message was created.

executeAtServerMs.description: Server monotonic timestamp in milliseconds when the command should execute.

executeAtClientMs.description: Optional receiver-local monotonic timestamp in milliseconds. When present, the receiver should use this instead of converting executeAtServerMs.

line.description: Optional source CSV line number copied from prepare.

finish.description: Coordinator informs the peer that the simulation has ended after the final fire message.

finish_ack.description: Peer acknowledges that it received the simulation finish message.

abort.description: Immediate cancellation of staged or running synchronized operation.
